mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_email, user_name, user_phone, user_profile_img, user_status FROM users WHERE user_status != 'DELETED'
SELECT user_id, user_email, user_pwd, user_name, user_phone, user_profile_img, user_status FROM users WHERE user_email = #{userEmail} AND user_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_email, user_pwd, user_name, user_phone) VALUES (#{userEmail}, #{userPwd}, #{userName}, #{userPhone})
